graph.layout: Float32[nodes][2] lon,lat then Uint16[edges][2] node indices, little-endian
graph.walkable_note: CSCL rw_type 1 street, 3 bridge, 5 boardwalk, 6 path, 7 step street, 10 alley; highways, tunnels, ramps, driveways, ferry routes and segments marked non-pedestrian dropped. Our rule.

routes.layout: Uint16[rows][nodes] predecessor per node, 65535 = unreachable; row index is route_row in gateways.json

assumptions: Which building a trip starts at is proportional to jobs. Nothing says the people leaving 195 Broadway at 5:40 work there.
The route is the shortest path, not the chosen path. Nobody walks the shortest path to the subway.
The gateway share is real - counted taps, MTA O-D 2024 - and a complex's flow splits evenly across its entrances.
